verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain's overview claims it supports enforcing open source package licensing requirements. It also documents a full dependency inventory and SBOM generation, which implies dependency licenses are detected. That evidence is a single high-level line, with no detail on how license policies are configured or how scans fail or block on violations. Missing for 10: documented license detection mechanics, policy configuration (allow/deny lists), evidence of enforcement during CI scans such as blocking or failing builds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans

citations.quote: Support the enforcement of your business’ open source package licensing requirements
Supply Chain's Dynamic Dependency Resolution provides a complete inventory of your project's dependencies
Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components
